title: Major raid defensive cooldowns — World of Warcraft Midnight 12.1

scope.definition: Player-controlled major damage reduction, immunity, avoidance, large absorption, emergency recovery, external or raid protection. High-impact short cooldowns are included; a long timer is not the definition of major. Passive effects appear only as gates, modifiers or attribution context.

field_conventions.paths: icon.file is relative to this JSON directory
field_conventions.base_cooldown: Includes inherent spec adjustments, excludes optional talents; specialization_profiles is authoritative for base values.
field_conventions.talent_rank: values_by_rank index 0 is rank 1. A one-element constant applies at all relevant ranks unless explicitly described otherwise.
field_conventions.access: AND all_of predicates; resolve selected_talent with the exact node/entry/rank and fight-time spec/hero tree. Inactive choice-node alternatives cannot be selected together.
field_conventions.operations: Declarative research rules; summary and trigger constraints are required. Not every effect modifier has a numeric operation. Do not execute blindly as a complete simulator.
field_conventions.modifier_applicability: Intersect modifier applicability specialization IDs with the affected ability specialization profiles; apply only_ability_spell_ids where present.
field_conventions.cooldown_vs_recovery: Static cooldown multipliers change the timer; recovery-rate modifiers accelerate countdown during an observed window. They are not interchangeable.
field_conventions.null: Unknown, variable or not numerically encoded; never interpret null as zero.
field_conventions.confidence: Sources establish the public-data model; actual cast/aura mapping and multi-modifier runtime behavior remain unvalidated unless explicitly noted.
field_conventions.single_talent_examples: One modifier at one rank applied to the specialization base, never an assertion that every listed example can be combined.

combination_policy.choice_nodes: Enforce current node alternatives before arithmetic.
combination_policy.static_stacking: Do not assume a universal flat-before-percent order. Store the selected modifiers; use a game-validated order or report provisional/unknown readiness.
combination_policy.dynamic_stacking: Replay observed events and aura intervals; concurrent recovery stacking must be verified.
combination_policy.scoring_when_uncertain: Do not report a definitive missed opportunity based solely on an unresolved timer.

audit_guidance.guidance: Resolve available / unavailable / unknown from the fight-start build, specialization and hero tree. Missing talent data is unknown, not proof a talent was absent. Current armory talents are not evidence of the historical fight build.

audit_guidance.topic: Separate access, readiness, usability and suitability
audit_guidance.guidance: A player may own a spell but have it on cooldown, lack a charge/resource/target, be locked out, or face damage it cannot mitigate. Only label a missed opportunity when all relevant conditions are supported.

Start with specialization-adjusted base timers, apply selected static modifiers, then replay resource spending, hit triggers, resets and time-varying recovery. Charges normally recharge sequentially. Missing trigger events must produce uncertain readiness, not an invented ready time.
Choice-node alternatives cannot coexist. Resolve replacement buttons, hero-tree selection, shared cooldown pools and Holy Armaments alternation before calculating availability.

Use aura applications/removals, stack counts, absorb depletion, pet/totem death and recipient positions where available. Nominal duration is not guaranteed protection. A ground-effect cast does not establish recipient coverage.

audit_guidance.topic: Keep cast origin and cost separate
audit_guidance.guidance: Distinguish player casts, automatic procs, triggered allied effects and player casts enabled for free by a proc. Store both activation_origin and cooldown_consumed; they are different questions.

Track school, direct/periodic damage, AoE classification, avoidability, reflectability, immunity bypass, source and target. Parry/dodge do not cover ordinary unavoidable raid AoE. Damage delay and transferred damage are not automatically prevented damage.

audit_guidance.topic: Account for the whole survival sequence
audit_guidance.guidance: Capture pre-hit health, maximum health, shield capacity, healing received/absorbed, delayed damage debt, source damage from transfers and deaths. A heal after a fatal hit gives no coverage for that hit. Debuff prevention can be valuable without large absorption.

Do not score uses divided by floor(fight length / nominal cooldown). Report dangerous eligible windows covered, ready-but-unused eligible windows, low-value uses, and uncertain cases with reasons. An early use can be worthwhile if it permits an additional later use.

Raw damage taken is already affected by defenses. Estimate prevented damage only when the event/mechanic model supports it; overlapping reductions usually combine multiplicatively. Do not credit each overlapping shield with the same prevented hit or compare self-heals directly to immunity percentages.

Include pre-pull casts and lookback state, encounter resets, deaths/resurrections, disconnected players and incomplete logs. Do not assume combat resurrection resets every cooldown. Pin this catalogue to its research date and select historical tuning for older pulls.

Include gear/set bonuses, external resets/recovery effects, item inventory, race, resources, weapon requirements, target range, control effects and recipient lockouts. These may change access/usability but are not fully enumerated as class abilities here.

Canonical spell IDs and Lorrgs groupings are candidate mappings, not a tested Warcraft Logs parser. Verify cast versus aura IDs, triggered effects, pets, recipients and shared pools against representative logs from each build before issuing definitive missed-use findings.

known_limitations: This is a dated research catalogue, not an executable or combat-log-validated cooldown simulator. No user fight logs were supplied for replay validation.

Individual static modifier values and simple examples are recorded. Ordering/stacking of multiple flat, percentage and recovery modifiers is not universally established by tooltips; unverified combinations must remain provisional.
Some effect strengths depend on stats, talent ranks or hidden aura details; the report deliberately avoids a universal single-number defensive-value score.
Some triggered spells share names or Lorrgs grouping records. Candidate event IDs must be validated against actual log event types before use.
Charges restored by Cold Snap, Fiery Brand self-aura extension, empowered hero recovery rates and historical hotfix boundaries need particular integration testing.
